label: preparing
what: Preparing to furnish the inn for overnight guests, specifically assessing space for two guest beds and establishing materials and a quote. Innkeeper and builder coordinated this assessment; baker knowingly relayed the request to builder, and freight relayed it to neighbour. No record shows the mayor being told of this specific joint bed/furnishing preparation, though the mayor knew generally of the innkeeper's lodging inquiries. No evidence of deliberate secrecy, approved paid work, completed installation, or a hidden celebration.
